environment.method: Exact source executed by Linkedom DOM contracts; compiled Worker syntax check

model_behavior.optional_companion: Only configured local CPU model; not selected automatically

checks: Sol is primary and no browser model/download/automatic inference control remains
Actual API receipt in fixture DOM never starts a paid interpretation automatically
Mobile evidence field and timeline have readable keyboard-scrollable viewports
Busy double-click issues one bounded manual request containing only evidence_id
Accepted Sol facts/provenance render safely and citations select native evidence
Cached manual result is visibly identified
Budget/cooldown failure preserves prior interpretation and never automatically retries
Mismatched returned evidence ID is rejected before attachment
Unverified provider attempt stays distinct from no model invocation
Missing model configuration retains deterministic evidence notes without claiming Sol ran
Export retains actual fixture evidence and full interpretation provenance
Second observation 304 is a non-redirect and cannot trigger automatic model calls
Pause preserves observations and interpretation without reconnecting
Missing authoritative storage prevents model requests despite a configured key
empty source has no invented graph records
untrusted source labels remain inert
real source relationships and record filters inspect normalized evidence
accepted model facts/hypotheses/provenance and fallback reasons render accurately
completed interpretations persist in evidence export payload
two large source batches remain capped at 2000 before analysis
local log sensor feed starts only on user click
empty successful feed stays connected without invented records
old source events remain visibly old after fresh polling
background, feed errors and manual pause preserve records with accurate health labels
authorized native capability auto-starts once only after source connected
native source graph includes actual symbolic components and public endpoint
control enforcement and functional checks do not become attack claims
native graph source and request/check/control filters use normalized records
manual pause survives repeated native capability updates
collector preflight with no HEAD stays inspectable and creates no target traffic arc
functional check labels remain declarations rather than verified authorization
imported sensor records do not invoke hosted paid interpretation
source polls and record selection never invoke the model
manual native interpretation calls callback once while pending
canonical edge source IDs select the actual inspector record
unconfigured hosted interpreter is honest and disabled
export click creates JSON containing source metadata, actual records, analysis and Sol provenance
mobile graph contract uses horizontal viewport with 840px SVG and 14/12px text rules
real graph viewport is keyboard focusable and carries a swipe/arrow hint
uncertain provider execution stays not verified while source facts and fallback reason remain visible
cached server result and canonical/requested evidence IDs render and survive JSON export

limitations: No live browser or pixel rendering proof; mobile readability is verified through DOM and CSS viewport contracts.
No actual Sol API invocation in these UI tests; accepted/rejected/cached/provider-uncertain states use clearly labelled fixture responses.
Server configuration and actual provider authorization remain separate parent-level acceptance checks.
Imported Suricata/Zeek and local-tail records remain browser evidence; paid server interpretation is limited to authoritative native server evidence.
